title: legitimoose.com
description: Legitimoose - Create & Share Your Own Minigame Worlds
body:
🦌 Legitimoose - Create & Share Your Own Minigame Worlds

A community-driven Minecraft server where creativity meets gameplay. Build and share custom minigame worlds powered by datapacks!

✨ What Makes Us Unique:
* Player-Created Worlds - Design your own minigame worlds with datapacks in the web!
* WorldEdit & Axiom Support - Powerful building tools for creators so you stay focused for longer
* Custom Resource Packs - Add your own textures and assets to show the true limits of what you can make!
* Extended Vanilla Behavior - Modify player data for advanced game mechanics!

🎮 Features:
* Multiple world slots to host your creations
* Advanced commands like /http, /inventory, and more
* MiniMessage formatting for chat and world descriptions
* Up to 4GB RAM per world for large projects (with Xtreme Moose)
* WorldEdit limits up to 5 million blocks (Ranks get higher limit)

💎 Support the Server:
Choose from multiple ranks (Apprentice, Full, Full Moose², Xtreme Moose) to unlock enhanced building capabilities, extra world slots, and exclusive perks. You can find the full list at the store!

Join the community at legitimoose.com and start creating today!

Visit our store: https://store.legitimoose.com/


**Legiti.dev is a community-created project not offically partnered with Legitimoose**
